title: STADOS: Spectral-Temporal Adaptive Dark Object Subtraction for Radiometrically Harmonized Multi-Temporal Agricultural Vegetation Monitoring
description: A five-stage radiometric harmonization framework that generalizes classical dark-object subtraction into a multi-object, reliability-weighted, iteratively self-consistent correction, applied to multi-temporal Sentinel-2 NDVI monitoring of corn parcels near Coimbra, Portugal.
